comment: No source is published. The Frequency knob is configured with a display base of 1.0594631, which is the twelfth root of two, while process() raises two to the power of the same number: the tooltip therefore reads the knob in semitones and shows 261.63Hz to 349.23Hz where the oscillator actually runs 8.18Hz to 8372Hz. The fold is skipped entirely when the fold amount is zero or below, and the reflecting fold loop reflects about plus and minus one until the sample is back in range.
